# ProofRunner

Independent execution verification for agent-generated software.

Status: the checked-in web flow is a demo preview. API, receipt, HTTPS, and
OKX.AI availability must be confirmed against the deployed service.

## Human and agent surfaces

- Human interface: /
- Agent contract: /skill.md
- Demo PASS receipt: /examples/passed
- Demo FAIL receipt: /examples/broken

## Frozen API routes

- Inspect repository: POST /api/inspect
- Start verification: POST /api/verify
- Run status: GET /api/runs/{id}
- Receipt JSON: GET /api/receipts/{id}

## MVP limitations

- Canonical public GitHub repositories only
- Node.js and TypeScript only
- npm and pnpm lockfiles only
- No repository secrets or user-provided shell commands
- PASS covers only the checks named in the receipt
- Timeout and infrastructure failures are INCONCLUSIVE, never FAIL
